name: COMP101_L3_ControlStructures

relation_semantics.dependsOn: Pedagogical prerequisite. Control↔Boolean skills are mutual dependsOn by design.
relation_semantics.isRequiredBy: Inverse of dependsOn (OWL). A-Box is forward-only (dependsOn); do not expect asserted isRequiredBy triples.
relation_semantics.usesConcept: Subject relies on object Concept or Pattern. Range=Concept|Pattern. Skill/Algorithm usesConcept valid.
relation_semantics.isUsedBy: Inverse of usesConcept (OWL). Domain Concept; range = same union as usesConcept domain. A-Box is forward-only.
relation_semantics.implementedBy: Concept is realized/expressed by a ConceptCarrier (LanguageConstruct, Operator, BuiltInFunction, or DataType). OWL: domain=Concept, range=ConceptCarrier. A-Box: Concept→LanguageConstruct / Operator / DataType. Domain is Concept only — never Algorithm (algorithms use usesConstruct for carriers). Multiple carriers per concept are normal.
relation_semantics.implementsConcept: Inverse of implementedBy (OWL). A-Box asserts only implementedBy.
relation_semantics.usesConstruct: Algorithm is coded with / employs a ConceptCarrier (LanguageConstruct, Operator, BuiltInFunction, or DataType). OWL: domain=Algorithm, range=ConceptCarrier. Distinct from usesConcept (→Concept) and from implementedBy (Concept→carrier). Never propose usesConstruct with a Concept object.
relation_semantics.constructUsedBy: Inverse of usesConstruct (OWL). A-Box asserts only usesConstruct.
relation_semantics.acceptsType: BuiltInFunction → DataType (values of that type as inputs).
relation_semantics.acceptedBy: Inverse of acceptsType (OWL). A-Box asserts only acceptsType.
relation_semantics.operatesOnType: Operator|Concept → DataType. Index/Element Traversal use this for supporting types.
relation_semantics.operatedOnBy: Inverse of operatesOnType (OWL). A-Box asserts only operatesOnType.
relation_semantics.producesType: Subject yields values of the object DataType.
relation_semantics.isProducedBy: Inverse of producesType (OWL). A-Box asserts only producesType.
relation_semantics.throwsError: Subject is associated with an ErrorType that can arise from incorrect use in this course. OWL: domain=owl:Thing, range=ErrorType; comment allows language construct, function, method, OR concept. This module's A-Box includes LanguageConstruct→ErrorType, BuiltInFunction→ErrorType, and Concept→ErrorType — Concept subjects are allowed when the ontology links a taught concept to a typical error. Range must remain ErrorType (never retarget to another Concept).
relation_semantics.isThrownBy: Inverse of throwsError (OWL). A-Box asserts only throwsError.
relation_semantics.methodOf: Method belongs to / is callable on the object DataType. OWL: domain=Method, range=DataType. Unused in this lecture's A-Box.
relation_semantics.hasMethods: Inverse of methodOf (OWL). Unused in A-Box.
relation_semantics.contrastsWith: Two entities that are alternatives, opposites, or commonly confused and should be distinguished. OWL domain/range owl:Thing; this module's A-Box is Concept↔Concept only. Not a prerequisite (dependsOn) and not a usesConcept link.
relation_semantics.taughtIn: Entity is introduced or explicitly taught in the object Lecture. OWL: domain=Thing, range=Lecture. External-evidence gated for the judge.
relation_semantics.teaches: Inverse of taughtIn (OWL). A-Box asserts only taughtIn.

competency_questions.question: Which concepts does 'Control Program Execution' use?
What does 'Trace Program Execution' depend on?

Which builtins accept a data type?

Which algorithm uses the Accumulator Pattern?

authoring_policy: Lecture 3. Algorithm = named computational procedure (not syntax demos). Patterns: Accumulator, Early-Exit Loop, Sentinel-Controlled Loop. Index contrastsWith Element Traversal. enumerate() is BuiltInFunction. operatesOnType domain Operator|Concept.
